audit_report.title: Section 1: Incident Management & Reliability Engineering Audit

findings.details: Comprehensive severity levels defined (SEV-1 Critical, SEV-2 High, SEV-3 Medium, SEV-4 Low) with clear characteristics, examples, response requirements, and target resolution times. SEV-1: 2hr resolution, SEV-2: 4hr resolution, SEV-3: 8hr/next business day, SEV-4: 30 days.
findings.recommendation: Consider using standardized SEV-0 to SEV-3 nomenclature for industry alignment. Current SEV-1 to SEV-4 is acceptable but non-standard.

findings.details: On-call rotation table structure defined with Primary On-Call, Secondary On-Call, and Manager On-Call columns. References to PagerDuty/OpsGenie for schedule management. Weekly rotation structure established.
findings.recommendation: Populate the contact list with actual team member details. Currently template placeholders [Name] need to be filled in before go-live.

findings.details: Clear 4-level escalation matrix: Level 1 (0-15 min) - On-Call Engineers, Level 2 (15-30 min) - Team Leads, Level 3 (30-60 min) - Engineering Manager/VP/External Support, Executive Level (60+ min) - CTO/CEO/Legal. Escalation triggers clearly defined.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit phone tree automation through PagerDuty escalation policies.

findings.details: Comprehensive SEV-1 runbooks for 8 critical scenarios: Discovery feed empty, Messaging down, Verification stuck, Payment webhooks failing, Calls failing, Auth service down, Database connection exhaustion, Redis cluster failure. Each includes symptoms, impact, diagnosis commands, and remediation steps.
findings.recommendation: Add runbooks for SEV-2 and SEV-3 scenarios. Consider adding runbooks for media-service and notification-service failures.

findings.details: Multiple communication templates provided: Status page templates (Investigating, Identified, Monitoring, Resolved), Slack update templates with severity/status/ETA, User email templates for service disruptions. Internal war room communication protocols defined.
findings.recommendation: Add templates for social media communications. Consider pre-approved messaging for payment/billing disruptions.

findings.details: Comprehensive PIR (Post-Incident Review) process documented: When to conduct (within 48 hours), meeting agenda (60 minutes broken into summary, timeline, RCA, response evaluation, action items, lessons learned), detailed PIR template with timeline tables, root cause analysis, prevention/detection/response improvements.
findings.recommendation: Add a blameless post-mortem culture statement. Consider using a tool like Jeli or Incident.io for structured retrospectives.

findings.details: Dedicated security incident runbook with P0-P3 severity classification, immediate response procedures (first 15 minutes), containment options (IP blocking, geo-blocking, service isolation), investigation phase, common scenarios (SQL injection, unauthorized storage access, container compromise), recovery phase with credential rotation, and post-incident documentation.
findings.recommendation: Add specific procedures for CSAM incidents (already exists in moderation service). Add breach notification timeline requirements for GDPR/CCPA.

findings.details: Detailed SLOs defined in Kubernetes ConfigMap format: API Service (99.95% availability, 99% latency <500ms, 99.9% success rate), Database Service (99.99% availability, 95% queries <100ms, connection pool <80%), Messaging Service (99.99% delivery, 99% latency <1s), Matching Service (90% accuracy, 95% <2s latency), User Experience (95% page load <3s, <0.5% crash rate).
findings.recommendation: Add SLOs for payment service (transaction success rate) and notification service (delivery rate). Consider tighter latency targets for mobile APIs.

findings.details: PrometheusRule recording rules for SLIs: api:success_rate (5m and 30d windows), api:latency (p50, p95, p99), api:availability, error_budget_remaining:30d, cache:hit_rate, database:connection_pool_utilization. Prometheus query expressions provided for each metric.
findings.recommendation: Add SLIs for WebSocket connection stability and real-time message delivery latency.

findings.subcategory: Error Budgets Tied to Release Velocity
findings.details: Error budget policy defined with 5 tiers: >50% remaining (normal development), 25-50% (prioritize reliability work), 10-25% (feature freeze), <10% (all hands reliability), Exhausted (rollback recent changes). Per-service error budgets calculated (e.g., API Gateway: 21.6 min/month, Messaging: 43.2 min/month).
findings.recommendation: Implement automated error budget consumption tracking in Grafana dashboard. Add release gate that blocks deployments when budget is <10%.

findings.details: ErrorBudgetBurnRateHigh alert configured to fire when budget consumed at 14.4x normal rate (burning 5% budget in 1 hour). Alert includes runbook URL and fires after 5 minutes of sustained burn.
findings.recommendation: Add slow burn rate alert (2x normal rate over 6 hours) as documented in slo-sla.md but not implemented in YAML.

findings.details: RDS Aurora alarms configured: CPU critical (>90%), connections high (>80% max), deadlocks (>5), read latency (>20ms), write latency (>50ms), replication lag (>100ms). Database composite alarm for combined health monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Add monitoring for Aurora Serverless scaling events and storage IOPS.

findings.details: ElastiCache Redis alarms configured: CPU high (>75%), memory high (>85% critical), evictions high (>1000), replication lag (>1s). Prometheus alerts for Redis down (2 min), memory high (90%), rejected connections.
findings.recommendation: Add cache hit rate alert threshold to detect caching degradation.

findings.details: SQS queue depth alarms configured with variable thresholds per queue. Dead letter queue monitoring with critical severity for any messages (>1). Alert fires immediately when messages land in DLQ.
findings.recommendation: Add age-of-oldest-message alarm to detect queue processing stalls.

findings.details: Payment webhook failure runbook exists (SEV-1-004) with diagnosis and remediation. However, no proactive SLO/SLI monitoring for Stripe webhook latency or success rate is configured in Prometheus rules.
findings.recommendation: Add custom metrics for payment provider latency and success rate. Create alerts for Stripe webhook signature validation failures and timeout rates.

findings.details: Comprehensive synthetic monitoring script with user journey tests: Health Endpoints (3 probes), Registration Flow, Login Flow, Discovery Flow, Rate Limiting verification. Tests include timing, error handling, and Slack webhook alerting for failures.
findings.recommendation: Schedule synthetic monitoring via CronJob in Kubernetes. Add synthetic tests for messaging send/receive and payment flow.

findings.details: Blackbox Exporter configured for HTTP probes (all services), TCP probes (Postgres, Redis, MongoDB), DNS probes. Alerts for endpoint down (2 min), slow response (>3s), SSL certificate expiring (30 days warning, 7 days critical), high HTTP error rate (>5%).
findings.recommendation: Add geographically distributed uptime checks. Consider adding Datadog or Pingdom for independent external monitoring.

findings.details: Helm deployments use --atomic flag which automatically rolls back on failure. Manual rollback workflow available with 'rollback' action. Rollback decision matrix in runbooks (P0 >10% error rate, P1 5-10%, P2 2-5%, P3 <2%). However, no automated rollback triggered by SLO/error-budget violations.
findings.recommendation: Implement Argo Rollouts or Flagger for automated progressive delivery with automatic rollback based on Prometheus metrics (error rate, latency SLO violations).

findings.details: Canary deployment script exists in deployment scripts. Pipeline uses staging->production approval gate. Blue-green deployment mentioned in OPERATIONS.md for production deploys.
findings.recommendation: Implement true canary releases with traffic shifting (10%->50%->100%) using Argo Rollouts or Istio. Add automated metric analysis during canary phase.

findings.details: Comprehensive Alertmanager configuration: Routes by severity (critical->PagerDuty, warning->Slack), service-specific routing (payment-service, auth-service, database), inhibition rules to reduce noise (node down suppresses pod alerts, database down suppresses service alerts), multiple Slack channels (#flamoral-critical, #flamoral-alerts, #flamoral-warnings, #flamoral-infrastructure).
findings.recommendation: Replace placeholder webhook URLs and PagerDuty keys with actual values. Test escalation paths before go-live.

findings.details: 840+ line Terraform module with alarms for: EKS (failed pods, CPU, memory, pending pods), RDS Aurora (CPU, connections, deadlocks, latency, replication), ElastiCache (CPU, memory, evictions, replication), ALB (5xx errors, unhealthy hosts, p99 latency), WAF (blocked requests, rate limiting), SQS (queue depth, DLQ). Composite alarms for database-health and application-health. Cost anomaly detection enabled.
findings.recommendation: Add alarms for API Gateway throttling and Lambda cold starts if applicable.

findings.details: Complete DR documentation including: DR_RUNBOOK.md, failover-procedure.md, failover-playbook.md, contact-list.md, backup-automation.sh, backup-scripts.sh, restore-from-backup.sh. RTO/RPO targets defined in slo-sla.md (Single service: 2min/0, DB failover: 5min/0, Region failure: 30min/5min).
findings.recommendation: Conduct quarterly DR drills and document results. Add runbook for cross-region failover if multi-region deployment is planned.

critical_gaps.impact: Unable to proactively detect payment processing degradation before it impacts revenue
critical_gaps.remediation: Implement custom Prometheus metrics for Stripe/payment provider latency and success rates

critical_gaps.impact: Manual intervention required to rollback failed deployments based on SLO violations
critical_gaps.remediation: Implement Argo Rollouts with AnalysisTemplates that query Prometheus for SLO compliance

critical_gaps.impact: Escalation contacts are template placeholders, not actual phone numbers and names
critical_gaps.remediation: Populate infrastructure/disaster-recovery/contact-list.md with real team member details before go-live

critical_gaps.gap: Slow Burn Rate Alert Not Implemented
critical_gaps.impact: Slow error budget consumption may not be detected until fast-burn threshold hit
critical_gaps.remediation: Add PrometheusRule for 2x normal burn rate over 6-hour window

recommendations_priority.action: Populate contact-list.md with actual team member details and test PagerDuty escalation
Replace placeholder webhook URLs in alertmanager-config.yaml with production values
Add payment provider latency and success rate metrics to Prometheus
Implement Argo Rollouts for automated canary deployments with rollback
Schedule synthetic monitoring as Kubernetes CronJob
Add slow error budget burn rate alert
Add SEV-2 and SEV-3 runbooks for non-critical service issues

blocking_issues: Contact list must be populated with real team member details
recommended_before_launch: Verify Slack webhook URLs are functional
